usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and orders, and Minutemailer gets the shopper as an email contact through “Create Email Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Email Contact” in Minutemailer
bestTemplate.why: The action adds the shopper to one or more mailing lists, so a left cart reaches your list.

watchOut: “Delete Contact” in Minutemailer removes a contact by email or UUID, so test it on a throwaway contact first.
